messages:
maya: quick q — UX tradeoff: do we keep compact saved-views scoped per-route (one savedquery per route) or let users layer shared presets across routes? users keep creating clones for slightly different routes 

jordan: what do you mean by 'layer'? like common filters + route-specific overrides?

maya: yeah exactly. infra flagged duplication in backend (lots of similar savedqueries) and product is worried about discoverability. wanted thoughts before convo with eng-platform.

liam: +1 for base presets + overlays. keep canonical presets global, allow 'pin to route' which creates a lightweight overlay that references the base id instead of copying. avoids full duplication.

sophia: telemetry note — if overlays reference base ids we can attribute usage to both base and pin targets, but need to ensure quota/cost calc is per-route request not per-savedview object. current billing uses route tag so should be fine.

jordan: implementation-wise we'd need the console API to support a composed view model. something like:
```json
{
  "base_preset_id": "preset_123",
  "overrides": { "filters": [{"field": "model", "value": "redwood-1"}] },
  "pin_metadata": {"pinned_by": "maya", "pinned_at": 1758000000}
}
```

liam: exactly. small backend change: store overlay as delta (sparsely). UI resolves by merging base + overlay at render time. rollback should be easier too.

maya: UX concerns: listing. People expect to see 'My saved views' under a route and not have to dig into global presets. Suggested: route view lists show both pinned overlays and a "Suggested presets" section pulling from global.

sophia: telemetry/rollout idea — start canary in Console Beta for teams with >10 routes and track click-to-apply and duplicate-save events. If duplicates drop, we consider broad rollout. Need SLO for query fetch latency (must remain <120ms).

liam: FYI ops-bot just deployed small change to savedquery cache warmers that helps render speed. (reacted :rocket: by jordan)

ops-bot: deploy: savedquery-cache-warmers v2 -> prod (1758000300) — no errors.

jordan: action items: 1) eng-platform to spec overlay storage (liam), 2) product to mock route-list UX with pinned + suggested (maya), 3) eng-telemetry to add duplicate-save metric and sampling (sophia). I'll schedule 30m sync Thurs.

maya: thanks — i'll do mocks and include an accessibility note about keyboard quick-pin. tagging @liam and @sophia for follow-up. :thumbsup:

liam: will draft API contract and delta format by EOD Friday.

sophia: will add telemetry events + dashboard tile for the canary by Monday.

maya: perfect. closing thread for now, will reopen with mocks.
